decisions.reason: After two years without visible failure, this close-to-core cutting and creasing finisher likely meets at least modest aspiration levels, and slack released by dropping the more distant product supports keeping it.
As a direct modular complement to the established workflow offer, the sheet preparation module is likely judged above aspiration and worth retaining as part of the core system logic.
The B2 multifinisher remains a flagship closely aligned with the firm's automation direction, so boundedly rational management would be reluctant to withdraw it absent clear underperformance.

The hybrid saddle stitcher fits the traditional booklet-making business, but as a somewhat more specific configuration it still carries some uncertainty even though it remains more likely than not to be kept.
The folding add-on unit already had early customer-use evidence and is tightly connected to the firm's installed base, making withdrawal within the coming year unlikely.
